about_short_description.short_description: Dashlabs.ai accelerates access to healthcare by providing DIY lab software that automates tests and simplifies lab management processes.

product.name: Laboratory Information System (LIS)
product.description: A cloud-based system that automates lab result transmission from machines to electronic health records, supporting bi-directional integration and result verification.

product.name: Electronic Health Records (EHR)
product.description: A cloud-based platform for storing, managing, and accessing comprehensive patient health records including lab, imaging, and consultation results.

product.name: Cashier Module
product.description: A healthcare-specific cashier system that manages sales transactions linked to patients, supports multiple pricing schemes, and allows split payments.

product.name: Results Input Forms
product.description: Digital forms for inputting patient test results across various services including lab tests, imaging, consultations, and prescriptions.

product.name: Download and Email PDF Results
product.description: A feature to generate, download, and email patient result documents as PDFs, with options for customization and password protection.

product.name: PACS and DICOM Viewer
product.description: An integrated viewer for managing and analyzing DICOM medical imaging files directly within the electronic health record system.
